subject: Azure co-sell: Referral stewardship & seller ownership handrails
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: PartnerCenter Ops <partnercenter@contoso.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Azure co-sell: Referral stewardship & seller ownership handrails

Team —

Putting this thread together to finalize operational handrails for Partner Center referrals so field sellers and partner ops have a single source of truth. Context: Contoso has a set of inbound marketplace leads (high-touch) and multiple field sellers have overlapping account claims in Partner Center. We need a lightweight stewardship model so referrals get routed consistently and consent is captured where required.

Key asks:
- Vanessa/Karthik: review the attached draft-handoff-matrix.xlsx and flag any contested accounts / ownership gaps.
- PartnerCenter Ops: confirm whether Partner Center will accept an "ownership override" token from RDW if we provide the consent audit (i.e., can you honor a partner-supplied owner change within 24 hours?).
- Neha: capture the final decision and add to the Field Sell Playbook.

I attached a working handoff matrix and the snippet of the consent emails we have so far. Short timeline: goal to publish the final routing rules and update the seller roster by EOD Monday (8/23).

Thanks —
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Partner Sales, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: draft-handoff-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 23 rows), consent-email-thread.pdf (PDF, excerpt)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, PartnerCenter Ops <partnercenter@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Referral stewardship & seller ownership handrails

Thanks Grace — quick read-through. High level takeaways:

- The draft matrix looks good. I flagged 6 accounts where both our AE and the Contoso seller have active claims in Partner Center (see tab "contested").
- For contested accounts, propose the following handrail:
  1) If Contoso seller has explicit consent recorded in Partner Center, they retain ownership.
  2) If consent is missing but our AE has a documented sales motion (POC or SOW > $50k), allow a 48-hour temporary routing to RDW AE and trigger immediate outreach to Contoso seller for consent.
  3) If neither exists, route to regional partner ops for manual triage.

Two operational questions for PartnerCenter Ops: can you expose the claim timestamps in the referral export? That will let us automate the 48-hour window. Also: what is the programmatic API for changing owner vs creating an escrow event?

I'll take point on the contested list outreach once we confirm the rule. Looping Karthik for fallback model decisions.

-Vanessa

Vanessa / Grace —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few notes from the Partner Center side:

1) We can provide claim timestamps in the referral export (created_at, claimed_by, claim_source). We'll add those fields to the CSV export for your ops team.
2) We do not support unilateral owner overrides without an audit trail. However, Partner Center accepts a partner-submitted consent package (signed email or DocuSign) which our ops team will prioritize and process within 24 hours provided the evidence is complete. The partner needs to submit the consent package via the secure intake link below.
3) There is no native "escrow" object in PC today, but we can create a temporary tag/status ("escrow_pending") and route it to your regional partner ops queue.

Secure intake link (for consent packages): https://pc.partnercenter.contoso.com/intake/consent
Export schema (sample): https://pc.partnercenter.contoso.com/docs/export-schema.csv

If you'd like, we can run a one-off remediation where we accept a batch consent package for the 6 contested accounts Vanessa flagged. That would get them reconciled in Partner Center faster than manual single-item intake.

—PC Ops Team

Subject: Re: Azure co-sell: Referral stewardship & seller ownership handrails

Agree with Vanessa's handrail draft. A few concrete additions to operationalize:

1) Automated routing rules (priority order):
   a) partner_claimed_with_consent -> route to partner seller
   b) rdw_ae_claim_with_sales_motion -> route to RDW AE for 48 hours, automatic task assigned to Contoso seller to confirm consent (email template in Drive).
   c) escrow_pending -> regional ops triage queue (manual).

2) Escrow lifecycle: escrow_pending -> 72h timer -> if no consent, escalation to Sales Leader for decision (auto-Ping: sales-leads@redwood.ai).

3) Acceptance criteria for a batch consent package: signed email + partner account alias + consent timestamp. If PC Ops can accept batch, we'll prepare a single package for the 6 contested accounts by COB Friday (8/21).

Action items assigned:
- Vanessa: own outreach to Contoso sellers (start now).
- Grace: push for partnercenter batch intake and confirm API fields we need.
- Neha: schedule a 30-min playbook update sync for Monday 8/23 at 10:00am PT.

Thanks everyone — quick status and next steps below. Great alignment.

Status recap:
- PC Ops confirmed claim timestamps in export and accepts batch consent package (they will process within 24 hours once received).
- Vanessa completed outreach; 4 of 6 contested accounts responded and provided signed consent to partner ownership. Two accounts remain pending (listed in attached).
- Karthik and I agreed on the automated routing priority and the 48-hour temporary routing window.

Decisions:
- Final handrail: partner_claimed_with_consent > rdw_ae_claim_with_sales_motion (48h temporary) > escrow_pending -> ops triage.
- If contested account remains unresolved after escrow lifecycle, Sales Leader will decide.

Deliverables (owners + deadlines):
- Vanessa: upload consent package for the 4 resolved accounts to PC intake link by EOD today (attachments: consent-email-thread.pdf).
- Grace: coordinate batch package submission for the remaining 2 contested accounts with PC Ops by tomorrow 8/24.
- Neha: update Field Sell Playbook (section: "Partner Center referral stewardship") and circulate v1 by 8/25.

I've attached the final version of the handoff matrix (updated). Please review cell highlights for the two pending accounts. If no objections, I'll publish the routing rules in the Sales Playbook and push a notice to the seller roster.

Thanks —
Grace
